title: Christmas Morning on Lark Street
introduction: By 6:03 a.m. the living room on Lark Street looked as though a wrapping-paper factory had sneezed. Two exhausted parents are now trying to reconstruct, from a heap of crumpled wish lists and one suspiciously sticky carpet, exactly who put out what for Santa. Nobody has had coffee, and the dog is not talking.
preamble:
Five kids are involved. Determine each kid's age, pajamas and snack.
- **Kid**: Margo, Deshawn, Frankie, Rosalind and Yuki.
- **Age** (listed from younger to older): 8 years old, 9 years old, 10 years old, 11 years old and 12 years old.
- **Pajamas**: purple fleece pajamas, blue star pajamas, reindeer pajamas, snowflake pajamas and red flannel pajamas.
- **Snack**: a slice of fruitcake, peanut butter crackers, carrot sticks, oatmeal cookies and gingerbread.
Every kid has a different age, pajamas and snack, so within each category every item is used exactly once.
clues: The kid who wears snowflake pajamas is younger than 9 years old, and the kid who wears red flannel pajamas falls somewhere between 9 years old and 12 years old, matching neither.
The kid who leaves out gingerbread is 9 years old, and the kid who wears blue star pajamas and the kid who leaves out gingerbread are exactly one year apart.

The kid who wears blue star pajamas and the kid who leaves out oatmeal cookies are exactly one year apart, and Deshawn falls somewhere between the kid who leaves out gingerbread and the kid who leaves out oatmeal cookies, matching neither.
10 years old falls somewhere between Margo and Yuki, matching neither, and Yuki does not wear red flannel pajamas.
9 years old falls somewhere between Frankie and the kid who wears purple fleece pajamas, matching neither.
The kid who leaves out peanut butter crackers falls somewhere between Frankie and Yuki, matching neither.
The kid who leaves out a slice of fruitcake is younger than Margo.
